title: Delete the dead permanently-skipped test in w3_41_tutor_security_rules_test.dart

evidence.quote:
skip:
            'Structural check superseded by allow create: if isOwner(uid) '

why: The test 'completions write is still owner-only despite tutor read access' (lines 331-345) is permanently skipped with a comment saying it is superseded by the very next test ('...guard is not weakened by C2 change', line 347+), which already covers the same invariant. It carries no Linear id, so it sits inert in CI output forever; a reader scanning for security-boundary coverage sees a 'skipped' result next to a security-sounding name and cannot tell at a glance whether that indicates a real unverified gap or accepted redundancy.
recommendation: Delete the skipped test block; the following test already asserts the same isOwner(uid)-only invariant.
acceptance_criteria: grep for 'skip:' in w3_41_tutor_security_rules_test.dart returns nothing.
